hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(printf '%s' "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); if ! printf '%s' "$CMD" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+push'; then exit 0; fi; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); cd "$REPO" || exit 0; BASE=$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD main 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$BASE" ]; then CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD 2>/dev/null); else CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null); fi; printf '%s' "$CHANGED" | grep -q '^scout/' || exit 0; command -v poetry >/dev/null 2>&1 || pip install -q --break-system-packages poetry 2>/dev/null; FAIL=0; for d in scout/backend/events-api; do [ -d "$REPO/$d" ] || continue; echo "=== Testing $d ===" >&2; (cd "$REPO/$d" && poetry install --with dev --no-root --no-interaction --no-ansi -q 2>/dev/null && poetry run pytest tests/ -q) || FAIL=1; done; [ "$FAIL" -eq 0 ] || { printf '{"decision":"block","reason":"Scout unit tests failed — fix before pushing"}\n'; exit 2; }
hooks.statusMessage: Running Scout unit tests before push...
